body.statement: Let \(\mathfrak g_0,\mathfrak g_1,\ldots,\mathfrak g_m\in\mathfrak M_{n,K,d,\tau}\) have distinct oriented unions, and let \(\mathscr D_j=\{I:|I|\le s,\ \mathcal O_{\mathfrak g_j}(I)\ne\mathcal O_{\mathfrak g_0}(I)\}\). Every exact adaptive recovery tree has depth at least the minimum number of allowed targets whose union hits all \(\mathscr D_j\); in particular, pairwise disjoint nonempty \(\mathscr D_j\) imply depth at least \(m\) along the \(\mathfrak g_0\) transcript.
body.justification: The lemma isolates the exact legality condition missing from informal transfers of single-DAG separating-system lower bounds.
body.gap: ShanmugamKocaogluDimakisVishwanath2015SmallInterventions constructs an adaptive total-order transcript for a complete single DAG; it does not ensure simultaneous faithful mixture alternatives.
body.consumer: Every lower-bound construction in the frontier can be audited by listing one baseline and its full changed-target families.
